name: Satsujin baselines (2026-09-28)
_about: Reference builds for testing other setups against. Every profile fights every scenario on the same seeds (tools/baseline.ts). A new setup is judged against these rows, not against a number from memory.

rachel5.about: Rachel SS regulars (boss protocol, count as boss); the roadmap's target

tomb_knights.about: King's Tomb Knights (non-boss); Tornado Knight walls with Safety Wall + Heal

guild_regulars.about: Ymir's guild dungeon regulars; several see through Hiding

ymir.about: Soul of Ymir (MVP) and Ymir Emperium (1 damage a hit and a tick)

elite.about: Hardest regular per high area + the area MVPs (Desperate Njord, King Schmidt, Soul of Ymir)
